description: Create Amazon listings for up to 25 products — a REAL publication on the seller's Amazon account. Each product runs the full check again (Amazon's dry run included) and is refused with Amazon's own sentences if anything changed; a product whose barcode Amazon already knows becomes an offer on that existing item. Run check_amazon_readiness first and pass only ready products. Refused until the owner switches on AI publishing, and while listing creation is not armed on the Amazon connection. Returns created (with the ASIN or SKU and, in submitted, the price, currency, quantity and fulfilment the listing was sent with — quantityOmitted says why no quantity went out: stockNotTracked or stockUnknown; an FBA offer's quantity is Amazon's own), failed (reason, details) and notAttemptedIds. created means Amazon ACCEPTED the submission for processing, not that the listing is live or buyable: Amazon finishes it asynchronously, so check the outcome later with inspect_amazon_listings and never tell the user a listing is live from this result alone. Not idempotent: a product already listed fails with alreadyListed. The result echoes the workspace.

marketplaceId.description: One Amazon store by its id (APJ6JRA9NG5V4 is amazon.it, A1PA6795UKMFR9 is amazon.de). Required when more than one store is open for this write; the store must have passed its own dry run on the Amazon connection.

productIds.description: The products to publish, at most 25 ready ids from check_amazon_readiness.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.
